plugins.name: AccentColor
plugins.description: Change Discord's blurple accent (buttons, links, toggles) to any colour.

plugins.name: AlwaysShowTimestamps
plugins.description: Shows the time on every message in a group, not just when you hover.

plugins.name: AlwaysTrustLinks
plugins.description: Skips the "Leaving Discord" warning and opens links straight away. (English Discord only.)

plugins.name: AnonymiseFileNames
plugins.description: Renames files you upload so their original names (like IMG_2041 or your-real-name.pdf) aren't shared.

plugins.name: AutoCapitalize
plugins.description: Capitalizes the first letter of your messages (and optionally adds a full stop).

plugins.name: BetterTitle
plugins.description: Cleaner window title: drops the "Discord |" prefix and can show your unread count first.

plugins.name: BetterUploadButton
plugins.description: Clicking the + button next to the message box opens the file picker straight away. Right-click it for the usual menu.

plugins.name: BlurMedia
plugins.description: Blurs images and videos in chat until you hover over them. Handy when sharing your screen.

plugins.name: BlurNames
plugins.description: Streamer-safe: blurs names and previews in your DM list and member list until you hover them.

plugins.name: CallTimer
plugins.description: Shows how long you've been in a voice call, above your user panel.

plugins.name: Capri
plugins.description: Capri, the desktop mate, lives in your Discord window: she walks along the panels, sits on edges, lies down, dances to your music and naps. Pick her up and throw her. Art from the Capri Desktop project.

plugins.name: ChannelHeaderCleanup
plugins.description: Hides buttons you don't use in the channel header: calls, pins, invite.

plugins.name: ChannelTypingIndicator
plugins.description: Shows animated dots next to channels and DMs where someone is typing.

plugins.name: CharacterCounter
plugins.description: Shows how many characters you've typed and the limit (2000, or 4000 with Nitro) above the message box.

plugins.name: ChatBackground
plugins.description: Put an image behind your chat.

plugins.name: ChatBarCleanup
plugins.description: Hides chat bar buttons you never use: gift, GIF, stickers, apps and more.

plugins.name: ClearURLs
plugins.description: Strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, si, …) from links in messages you send.

plugins.name: CollapseLongMessages
plugins.description: Folds very long messages with a "Show more" button.

plugins.name: ConfirmCalls
plugins.description: Asks before starting a voice or video call, so you don't ring someone by accident.

plugins.name: ConsoleJanitor
plugins.description: Silences Discord's own console logging, so DevTools only shows what matters (errors and Vanta).

plugins.name: ConsoleShortcuts
plugins.description: Adds shortcuts to the DevTools console for plugin development: wp, findByProps, findByCode, common, Vanta.

plugins.name: CopyCodeBlocks
plugins.description: Adds a Copy button to code blocks in messages.

plugins.name: CopyEmojiMarkdown
plugins.description: Shift+click a custom emoji in chat to copy its code (like <:pog:1234>) so you can use it elsewhere.

plugins.name: CopyHoveredMessage
plugins.description: Hover a message and press Ctrl+C (with nothing selected) to copy its text.

plugins.name: CopyIds
plugins.description: Ctrl+Shift+click a message to copy its ID. Add Alt to copy the author's user ID instead.

plugins.name: CopyImageLink
plugins.description: Shift+click an image in chat to copy its link.

plugins.name: CopyInlineCode
plugins.description: Click `inline code` in a message to copy it.

plugins.name: CopyMessageLink
plugins.description: Ctrl+Alt+click a message to copy a link to it.

plugins.name: CrispText
plugins.description: Sharper, thinner text rendering (grayscale anti-aliasing).

plugins.name: CursorPet
plugins.description: A tiny void orb that follows your mouse around and dozes off when you stop moving.

plugins.name: CustomFont
plugins.description: Use any font installed on your computer for Discord's text and code.

plugins.name: CustomRPC
plugins.description: Show any "Playing…" status you like on your profile. Needs an Application ID from discord.com/developers.

plugins.name: DevToolsKeybind
plugins.description: Ctrl+Shift+I or F12 opens DevTools (Discord blocks these by default).

plugins.name: DimWhenUnfocused
plugins.description: Dims Discord when it's not the active window.

plugins.name: DoubleClickActions
plugins.description: Double-click a message to reply to it, or double-click your own message to edit it.

plugins.name: F5Reload
plugins.description: F5 reloads Discord, like a browser (Ctrl+R still works too).

plugins.name: FixEmbeds
plugins.description: Swaps Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, Bluesky and Pixiv links for versions that show a proper preview in Discord.

plugins.name: FluxLogger
plugins.description: Logs Discord's internal events (Flux actions) to the DevTools console. For plugin developers.

plugins.name: FocusMode
plugins.description: Press Ctrl+Alt+F to hide the server list, channel list and member list, leaving just the chat.

plugins.name: FriendsSince
plugins.description: Shows when you became friends with someone on their profile.

plugins.name: GrayscaleMode
plugins.description: Turns Discord black and white. Less distracting when you're trying to focus.

plugins.name: HiddenChannels
plugins.description: Shows which channels in a server you can't see (names, categories and topics), in a read-only list.

plugins.name: HideActiveNow
plugins.description: Hides the "Active Now" column on the Friends page.

plugins.name: HideAttachButton
plugins.description: Hides the + (upload) button in the message box. Drag-and-drop and paste still work.

plugins.name: HideAudioMenus
plugins.description: Hides the little arrows next to Mute and Deafen in your user panel.

plugins.name: HideBadgeCounts
plugins.description: Hides red mention/unread number badges on servers and DMs (the unread dot stays).

plugins.name: HideBotMessages
plugins.description: Hides messages from bots (and webhooks). Turn off to see them again.

plugins.name: HideGifTag
plugins.description: Removes the little "GIF" label on GIFs in chat.

plugins.name: HideLinkEmbeds
plugins.description: Hides link previews (embeds) under messages. Images and videos you upload still show.

plugins.name: HideMentionBars
plugins.description: Hides the "new mentions" bars at the top and bottom of chat.

plugins.name: HideMessagesWith
plugins.description: Hides messages containing words or phrases you never want to see (spoilers, slurs, topics).

plugins.name: HideProfileFlair
plugins.description: Hides avatar decorations, server tags and profile effects for a cleaner chat.

plugins.name: HideReactions
plugins.description: Hides reactions under messages.

plugins.name: HideReplyPreviews
plugins.description: Hides the quoted line above replies. You still see who replied, just less clutter.

plugins.name: HideRoleIcons
plugins.description: Hides the small role icons next to names.

plugins.name: HideStatuses
plugins.description: Hides what people are playing and their custom statuses in the member and DM lists.

plugins.name: HideStickers
plugins.description: Hides stickers in chat (or blurs them until hovered).

plugins.name: HideSystemMessages
plugins.description: Hides join messages, boosts, pins and other system messages.

plugins.name: HideTypingIndicator
plugins.description: Hides "someone is typing…" under the message box.

plugins.name: HideUpsells
plugins.description: Removes Nitro, Shop and Quests links from your DM list, plus the gift button.

plugins.name: HighlightMyMessages
plugins.description: Gives your own messages a subtle tint so they're easy to spot in busy chats.

plugins.name: HighlightUsers
plugins.description: Gives messages from people you choose a coloured background, so you never miss them.

plugins.name: HoverBarCleanup
plugins.description: Trims the buttons that appear when you hover a message.

plugins.name: HoverReactKeys
plugins.description: Hover a message and press 1, 2 or 3 to add one of your quick reactions. No clicking.

plugins.name: IgnoreUsers
plugins.description: Hides messages from people you list, without blocking them. Paste user IDs (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+click a message with CopyIds).

plugins.name: ImageFilename
plugins.description: Hover an image or video in chat to see its file name.

plugins.name: ImageZoom
plugins.description: When you open an image, scroll to zoom in where your mouse is. Click to reset.

plugins.name: InlineCalc
plugins.description: Write {= 12*4 + 3} in a message and it's replaced with the answer when you send.

plugins.name: KeyboardSounds
plugins.description: Soft typewriter clicks while you type in the message box. Generated live, no sound files.

plugins.name: KeywordAlerts
plugins.description: Get notified when a message anywhere mentions words you care about, like your name or a game.

plugins.name: LastSeen
plugins.description: Remembers when each friend was last online. Open this plugin's settings to see the list.

plugins.name: MediaCorners
plugins.description: Change how rounded images and videos in chat are.

plugins.name: MemberCount
plugins.description: Shows how many members a server has, and how many are online, at the top of the member list.

plugins.name: MentionHighlight
plugins.description: Pick your own colour for messages that mention you.

plugins.name: MessageLogger
plugins.description: See deleted and edited messages. Deleted ones stay in chat marked red, edits show what they said before, and everything goes into a log.

plugins.name: MuteNewServers
plugins.description: When you join a server, it's muted with @everyone and role pings suppressed, so new servers don't flood you.

plugins.name: NetworkLogger
plugins.description: Logs every API request Discord makes to the DevTools console. For plugin developers.

plugins.name: NoBlockedMessages
plugins.description: Messages from people you've blocked disappear completely, instead of showing as "blocked message".

plugins.name: NoChatAvatars
plugins.description: Removes avatars from chat for a compact, IRC-like look.

plugins.name: NoDevToolsWarning
plugins.description: Removes the giant "Hold Up!" warning Discord prints in DevTools, so the console stays readable.

plugins.name: NoJumboEmoji
plugins.description: Messages that are only emoji show them at normal size instead of huge.

plugins.name: NoReplyMention
plugins.description: Never @mention the person you're replying to (the reply ping toggle is forced off).

plugins.name: NotificationVolume
plugins.description: Makes Discord's notification and UI sounds quieter (or louder, up to normal) without touching call volume.

plugins.name: NoTrack
plugins.description: Blocks Discord's analytics (science/metrics) requests and Sentry crash reporting.

plugins.name: OnlineFriendsCount
plugins.description: Shows how many friends are online next to "Friends" in your DM list.

plugins.name: OpenInApp
plugins.description: Spotify and Steam links open in their desktop apps instead of your browser.

plugins.name: PasteLinks
plugins.description: Select some text in the message box and paste a link: it becomes a clickable [text](link).

plugins.name: PictureInPicture
plugins.description: Adds a picture-in-picture button to videos in chat so you can keep watching while you scroll.

plugins.name: PinDMs
plugins.description: Pin your favourite DMs: hover a DM and click the pin, and it stays in a row at the top of your DM list.

plugins.name: PlatformIndicators
plugins.description: Shows whether people are on desktop, phone or web, next to their names in chat, the member list and DMs.

plugins.name: QuickReply
plugins.description: Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down pick a message to reply to, without touching the mouse. Ctrl+Down past the newest message cancels the reply.

plugins.name: ReadableWidth
plugins.description: Keeps chat lines from stretching across ultrawide screens.

plugins.name: ReadAllNotifications
plugins.description: Adds a "Read all" button above your server list that clears every unread server at once.

plugins.name: ReduceMotion
plugins.description: Turns off animations and transitions. Makes Discord feel snappier on slow PCs.

plugins.name: RelationshipNotifier
plugins.description: Tells you when someone unfriends you, cancels a friend request, or removes you from a server or group chat.

plugins.name: RevealAllSpoilers
plugins.description: Ctrl+click a spoiler to reveal every spoiler in the channel at once.

plugins.name: ReverseImageSearch
plugins.description: Alt+Shift+click an image in chat to look it up with Google Lens, Bing, Yandex or TinEye.

plugins.name: SafeMentions
plugins.description: Stops your messages from pinging @everyone, @here or roles by accident (the text still shows).

plugins.name: SendGuard
plugins.description: Stops a message from sending if it contains words you list (an old password, a slur, a name), so you can fix it.

plugins.name: ServerHotkeys
plugins.description: Alt+1 … Alt+9 jumps to your first nine servers (in sidebar order).

plugins.name: ServerListCleanup
plugins.description: Hides the Add a Server and Discover buttons and the separator lines in the server list.

plugins.name: ShowMeYourName
plugins.description: Shows people's @username next to their display name in chat, so you always know who's who.

plugins.name: Signature
plugins.description: Adds a signature line to the end of messages you send.

plugins.name: SilentMessages
plugins.description: Sends your messages as @silent so they don't push-notify anyone (mentions still show up).

plugins.name: SilentTyping
plugins.description: Hides your typing indicator from other people.

plugins.name: SmartPunctuation
plugins.description: Typographer's touches: -- becomes —, ... becomes …, -> becomes →.

plugins.name: SpoilerUploads
plugins.description: Marks every file you upload as a spoiler.

plugins.name: SuppressEmbeds
plugins.description: Sends links without a preview underneath (like wrapping every link in < >).

plugins.name: TextEffects
plugins.description: Start a message with !owo, !mock, !up, !rev, !wide, !small, !clap or !spoil to transform it.

plugins.name: TextReplace
plugins.description: Automatically replaces words or patterns in messages you send, using your own rules.

plugins.name: ThemeAttributes
plugins.description: For theme makers: adds data-author-id, data-is-self and data-is-bot to messages so themes can style them.

plugins.name: ThemeHelper
plugins.description: For theme makers: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+click anything to copy a selector for it that survives Discord updates.

plugins.name: ThinScrollbars
plugins.description: Slimmer scrollbars everywhere, or none at all.

plugins.name: TimestampShortcuts
plugins.description: Type {now}, {in 2h}, {at 9pm} or {tomorrow 18:00} and it becomes a timestamp everyone sees in their own time zone.

plugins.name: TitleBarCleanup
plugins.description: Hides the Help and Inbox buttons in the top bar.

plugins.name: Translate
plugins.description: Hover a message and press Ctrl+Alt+T to translate it. The text is sent to Google Translate.

plugins.name: TransparentWindow
plugins.description: See-through Discord with Windows 11 blur (acrylic or mica). Works best with a theme. May affect window snapping.

plugins.name: Unindent
plugins.description: Removes extra indentation from code blocks you send, so pasted code isn't pushed to the right.

plugins.name: VideoTweaks
plugins.description: Sets a default volume for videos in chat (no more full-blast clips), and can loop them.

plugins.name: ViewFullImages
plugins.description: Ctrl+click any avatar, server icon, emoji, banner or image to open it at full size in your browser.

plugins.name: ViewRaw
plugins.description: Ctrl+middle-click a message to see its raw text (with markdown) and copy it.

plugins.name: VoiceChannelAlerts
plugins.description: Tells you when people join or leave the voice channel you're in, and can say it out loud.

plugins.name: VoiceNarrator
plugins.description: Reads out who joins and leaves your voice channel, using your computer's text-to-speech voice.

plugins.name: YouTubeShortLinks
plugins.description: Turns youtube.com/watch?v=… links into short youtu.be links (keeps the timestamp).
